flavor.phonemic_palette: Insular Celtic (Goidelic) backbone (initial mutation; broad/slender consonants; -aj/-an endings) with a Germanic overlay (the Gund- dithematic ruling-names, -burg/-reiks); theophoric on the Celtic morphs (Toran-, Orlann-) with Germanic variants (Thulrs-, Erlands-).
flavor.phenotype_notes: Synthesis of Germanic + Celtic per setting-lore §5.3 (blend the listed features; exclude the inverse).

magic_attitude.notes: Germanic + Celtic register; deity-morphs in name_bank 'gundic'.

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore §4.2): Lawful venerates the 12 Lawful powers and names the 13 as demons; Chaotic venerates the 13 and names the 12 as tyrant-gods; Neutral venerates this culture's ancestral saints, invoking the great gods only situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Gundic — wary clan confederation of the forest; honor, freedom.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Gundic (Germanic + Celtic) are a assertive clan confederation people seeded in forest, grassland, dense forest. They prize honor, freedom, hospitality, lean toward the military sphere, and field heavy_infantry, light_cavalry, berserkers. Outsiders are met as wary; their patrons touch war, nature, storms.
